- Spielstände, INI-Editor und Programme sind klarer beschriftet

Bug Fixes:
- Hop Across: Adler-Timer und Münzvergabe laufen jetzt zuverlässig weiter
- Fortschritt und Einstellungen bleiben auch nach einem Neustart erhalten

notesLocalized.en-US:
Halloween Update 🎃

New:
- Hop Across 1.1: 100 skins, new worlds and power-ups (shield & slow-mo)
- Daily bonus with streaks, a three-tier daily challenge and your own leaderboard
- Quests, level/XP and 24 achievements – rewards are credited instantly
- Mod manager: apply your mods in one click, with automatic game-folder detection
- Mod manager: plain-language wording for newcomers – "VFS" is now "Mods in game"

Improvements:
- Hop Across: new hazard warnings, a smoother highway and reworked menus
- Crates now show collection milestones (10/25/40/60/80/100 skins)
- Savegames, INI editor and tools are labelled more clearly

Bug Fixes:
- Hop Across: the eagle timer and coin crediting now keep running reliably
- Progress and settings survive a restart
